answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 152573 Country: India Title: Doing business of selling food only of restaurants which sell food and also alcohol. Question: We are doing business of online food ordering where we tie up with various restaurants and put their menus online and customer place an order on our apps. We get requests from restaurants to sell their food on our website and apps. These restaurants have food menu and also alcohol menu. I want to know is it permissible to partner these restaurants for selling food only and no alcohol. Please advise soon. Answer ID: 152573 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1300/1249/N=11/1438) Yes, you can become a partner with the restaurant only in selling halal and lawful food as per the Shariah and the alcohol which the restaurant sells it shall have no effect on you. However you only publish halal and lawful food menu on your website and do not include haram and unlawful food and alcohol in the list. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
